properties.name: Cache 1

o2_min.source: MarsWalk scenario assumption: 120 nominal O2-min per cache (one quarter of the 8 h suit supply, enough to get home from anywhere in the 800 m operating area). Refill concept: suit O2 top-off through an umbilical (Campbell et al. 2017, CTSD-ADV-959 Rev A, sec. 3.2.5.5.2).

properties.notes: Greedy k-center, k=1; zone: radio operativo 800 m; worst case before/after: 34.47/31.46 nominal O2 min. Final worst case: 28.70; threshold: 10.00; threshold_met: false.
